[[File:MilitaryTravelPack.jpg|200px|thumb|A close-up view of a coolth backpack]]
A '''coolth backpack''', also known as a '''military travel pack''', was a personal device that incorporated [[Coolth/Legends|coolth]] chemicals into a portable [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] for use on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] with hot climates, such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

The coolth backpack was fitted with a cooling unit, through which was pumped cold coolth to maintain the wearer's temperature. These packs also featured a [[sunshield fabric]] which could be unrolled from the unit's lower section. This backpack was a more lightweight alternative to the [[coolth suit]] worn in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] among other areas.
